# Sam Rahim

> I help businesses grow and build things you can hold, visit, or experience. I spent the last decade working for high-growth startups like Street FC, Switchyards and Guild.

## Current projects
- [The Extra Times](https://playextratimes.com): A newspaper of football games, puzzles and challenges.
- [Newspaper Department](https://newspaperdepartment.com): Newspapers people play, made for brands.

## Work
- Newspaper Department, Founder (2026–now): I publish game newspapers and make them for brands. [See the papers](https://newspaperdepartment.com)
- Consulting, Independent Consultant (2025–now): I work with founders + operators across industries, from GTM to standing up operations. [See the work](https://provisions.work)
- Switchyards, Go To Market + Special Projects (2025): Managed our influencer and creator program, field marketing, and growth projects. Helped open and sell out 8 clubs.
- Street FC, Head of Operations (2021–2025): Venture-backed global football brand. Grew it to millions in revenue and worked with Nike, Adidas, and EA Sports. Fundamentally changed the way soccer looks in the United States.
- Guild Education, Associate, Product Operations (2021–2022): Guild helps working adults access free education. I worked on the product team, across our data exchange product and internal product operations.
- The Walt Disney Company, Operations Manager (2019–2021): Helped develop and run luxury group travel experiences around the world, from intern to full-time. Also where I met my wife.
- Lokal Travel, The Generalist Intern (2017–2019): Lokal Travel helps travelers find locally-run tour operators, keeping tourism dollars in the destination.
